protocol: R29 listwise-competition VCS main alignment (NEXT_EXPERIMENTS_CN.md, global review 637ba390, 2026-11-01)
frozen_before: any formal R29 unit and before the R29 GPU smoke/gate; no R29 training or DEV result of any kind seen. Only the R29 CPU checks (synthetic float64 data, job 1079393 ALL_PASS) had run.

arms.h_native: H: native A1 recipe from scratch: warmup cross-modal infonce(sims) (SCE = CE+RCE, tau 0.05, batch mean, x1 per direction pair as in VSE.train), co-train loss_1 = ContrastiveLoss hinge (margin 0.2, max violation, batch sum). Diagonal-only positives (native).
arms.n_infonce: N: task-native InfoNCE, row loss -sum_j a_j log softmax(s/tau)_j (multi-positive CE).
arms.p_pointwise_vcs: P: original J with pointwise critic T_ij = tanh(s_ij/tau + b); reads only its own score; b one learnable scalar per peer (init 0, own AdamW group, lr = model lr schedule, weight_decay 0, not grad-clipped).
arms.l_listwise_vcs: L: original J with listwise critic T_j = (K pi_j - 1)/(K pi_j + 1) = tanh(log(K pi_j)/2), pi = softmax(s/tau) over the candidate list.
arms.b_listwise_bce: B: same pi/T as L, D = (1+T)/2 = sigmoid(log K pi); row loss -sum_j a_j log D_j - (1/K) sum_j log(1 - D_j).

J: J(T, a) = sum_j a_j (T_j - T_j^2/2) - (1/K) sum_j (T_j + T_j^2/2); P = P_(Z,I), Q = P_Z x Unif(K) (uniform candidate-slot permutation applied analytically as the mean over the K slots; no K-fold training).
candidates: in-batch candidates of the original batch (batch 128): i2t query = image row, candidates = the B captions; t2i query = caption, candidates = the B image rows; K = B. Same lists for N/P/L/B.
target_rule: training-visible multi-positive identity: candidate j is a positive of query i iff observed image id (dataset.t2i_index after the noise file) of j equals that of i; a uniform over the positives (diagonal included). Injected-noise truth (_t2i_index / _labels) is never read. 0% = original pairing (arange(N)//5), no artificial shuffling.
outer_scale_rule: reduction matching (one rule, all arms): the replacement keeps the native term reduction in each phase. warmup: 0.5*(mean_rows i2t + mean_rows t2i) (native SCE 0.5 per direction, batch mean); co-train: sum_rows i2t + sum_rows t2i (native hinge sum over rows of both directions). Alignment-term gradient norms are recorded (report only; never used to rescale or to interpret a larger norm as a mechanism gain).
intervention_location: warmup cross-modal term (VSE.train mode=warmup: infonce(sims)) AND the reliable (labeled / clean-split) pair alignment loss_1 of co-training. NOT the noisy-prototype auxiliary.
unchanged_for_all_arms: intra-modal terms (warmup infonce(img_sims)+infonce(cap_sims); co-train hinge margin 0.3 x2)
noisy branch = R27 A1 interface (arm a1_iface, lam 0: other-peer ID search, current-peer re-encoding, native GraphRefiner + SCE x0.5 per direction)
GMM split: native eval_train with the native eval_loss hinge per-sample score, p_threshold 0.5
FIFO enqueue of high-confidence clean pairs
AdamW lr 5e-4, x0.1 at co-train epoch 15 (lr_update 15)
image-text cosine score for training and validation/test (peer-averaged)
init_and_budget: common UNTRAINED seed-determined initialization (r25_run.seed_all(seed) then VSE construction; identical for every arm of a seed; P adds b without consuming RNG). No common prefix is reused (they were trained with the native objective). Each unit: warmup 5 epochs + co-train 40 epochs (epochs 0..39) = the native protocol budget.

f00_s1001.init: common untrained seed-determined init (r25_run.seed_all(seed) + VSE construction); no prefix

f60_s1001.init: common untrained seed-determined init (r25_run.seed_all(seed) + VSE construction); no prefix

f60_s1002.init: common untrained seed-determined init (r25_run.seed_all(seed) + VSE construction); no prefix

f60_s1003.init: common untrained seed-determined init (r25_run.seed_all(seed) + VSE construction); no prefix

units.order: 10 seed1001 pilots first (0% then 60%; H,N,P,L,B), then H,N,L,B x 60% x seeds 1002, 1003 (main-session decision: 0% and P single-seed)

scheduling: normal QOS, --partition=RTX6000PRO,L40S,H100 --exclude=node51,node53,node60, nice 5, 10h time limit, self-continuation <= 3 attempts on timeout (resume from own state_last.pt), no --dependency; keep_states (epoch 10/20 full states). Hardware recorded per unit, not matched across arms (disclose).

endpoints.primary: best full-DEV rSum (peer-averaged native readout, max over the 40 co-train epochs)
report: six recalls (i2t/t2i R@1/5/10) at the same best checkpoint
per-epoch train diagnostics: alignment loss, alignment-term grad norm, listwise J readout, positive-top1, GMM split precision/recall (post hoc, evaluator only)
endpoints.later_analyses: correct hard samples, gradient contribution of injected mismatches, R@1 rank transitions: evaluator-only, after the units finish; not a selection criterion. J is never a substitute for the task endpoint.

decision_rules: NEXT_EXPERIMENTS_CN.md section 3 (five routes), applied by the main session after the matrix; no thresholds start or stop units.
no_selection_on_dev: one rule for all arms; no per-arm tau / scale / epoch / checkpoint choice on DEV; no K / hard-negative / teacher grids.
test: never read (stage.sh copies only train/dev; no TEST entry is run).
